title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: more indicator variants and larger detection groups
summary: Hold: the variant control sends administrators to create a new variant even when it says it covers editing an existing one. The higher limits and roadmap details are supported, but Microsoft does not explicitly support the assurances that existing configurations remain unchanged, no new data is read, and nothing acts autonomously.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Detections change only when an administrator uses the extra capacity, and otherwise existing policies, variants and groups carry on unchanged.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management variants new data collected existing policies unchanged automatically higher limits'; the higher-limits enable/default query. Opened policy-indicators, detection-groups and settings; no unchanged-existing-configurations statement found.
claims.fix: Replace the summary's second sentence with 'Administrators can use the extra room to tune detections; no separate higher-limits switch is documented.' Replace 'If nobody acts, existing policies, variants and groups carry on as configured' with 'No source says existing behaviour changes merely because these limits rise.' In the risk rationale, replace the unconditional 'detections change when' clause with 'administrators use variants and detection groups to tailor detections in policies or global exclusions'.

claims.claim: The feature reads no new data.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management detection groups indicator variants read data collection autonomous actions no changes limits'; the new-data/existing-policies query. Opened policy-indicators, detection-groups and settings; no no-new-data statement found.
claims.fix: Remove 'No change: the feature reads no new data.' Keep the documented statement that variants and detection groups change the scope of existing indicators.

claims.claim: Variants and detection groups change which activities existing indicators capture through exclusions or inclusions.
claims.quote: A variant inherits all the properties of the built-in indicator. You can modify the variant with exclusions or inclusions.

claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management detection groups indicator variants read data collection autonomous actions no changes limits'. Opened policy-indicators, detection-groups, settings and alert-tuning; no passage states that this change introduces no autonomous actions.
claims.fix: Replace the Autonomy & actions bullet with 'When variants are added to policies, the dashboard generates alerts.' Remove 'No change' and 'nothing acts on its own'.
